title: 💻 Apple Plans to Launch the MacBook Neo, iPhone 18, and iPhone 18e in Spring 2027!
body: 💻 Apple Plans to Launch the MacBook Neo, iPhone 18, and iPhone 18e in Spring 2027!
New reports suggest Apple plans to launch the next generation of the MacBook Neo between February and March 2027, at roughly the same time it launches the iPhone 18e and a new entry-level tablet.

This comes after the company launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max this year, along with its first foldable phone, while the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e were absent from the launch — so they were expected to arrive at a later date.

According to the report, the standard iPhone 18 and the next generation of the MacBook Air will arrive in the same spring period next year, while the first six months of 2027 are also expected to bring the iPad Air with an OLED display, the next generation of the iPad Pro, and the second generation of the slim iPhone Air.
But the report notes that the new mid-range tablet and some iPhone models are running slightly behind the manufacturing schedule, unlike the iPhone 18e and MacBook Neo, which are on track.
Apple has not confirmed any of these dates officially, and they all remain in the realm of reports and leaks — but they paint a picture of a busy spring full of the company's launches.
Simply put: spring 2027 could bring a whole batch of Apple devices all at once.. Will you wait for the new release or buy what is available now?
If Apple launches a laptop, a phone, and a tablet in a single month, which one are you waiting for most?
